note: A Golden Upgrade is a SAME-POSITION 1-for-1 where our canonical board prefers the target and the target's own market prefers the player we own. The two minimums below define 'meaningful enough to act on'; they are presentation thresholds, never values. Raise or lower them here — never in code. exploitBandPct / exploitZeroPct: an inversion whose board gain plus market inversion exceeds the band is flagged exploitRisk and its ranking strength decays to 0 at the zero point — a huge inversion usually means the two boards disagree about the players, not a clean upgrade (declared prior, same rule as Best Offers).
